scope: Real Chromium rendering and browser animations; synthetic native IPC and synthetic voice payloads. Full-screen Spaces are tested separately in AppKit.
checks: enter waits for actual native resize completion
listening bars visibly animate rather than remaining a static icon
listening to processing reuses visible shell with content crossfade
pill grows continuously into result; shell stays opaque; recovery copy still works
hover keeps compact rounded shadow and fully transparent canvas gutters
rapid updates and restart during exit cannot duplicate or remove current HUD
native hide occurs after exit animation and DOM removal
reduced motion settles immediately and terminal Close does not abort again
every outer-edge screenshot pixel has alpha zero, including hovered result
